wording_scope: Standalone Combat categories and category-specific references become Event. Non-Combat references are resolved to Setup or Drill. Physical Combat, Energy Combat and Combat timing remain distinct. Supplied Expanded CRD reviewed; previously deferred cards unchanged.

interpretation_notes.129: Event eligibility is a set-era category interpretation, supported by the explicit three-category distinction on Trunks #91. The CRD retains the historical Combat wording; it does not explicitly say Event.
interpretation_notes.rarity: Original scans and CRD support Uncommon = 3 stars and Rare = 5 stars. This batch uses those values; earlier published batches were not revised.

review_surfaces: Full-card inspection of representative and corrected cards
checks: Native outlined titles, rules, icons and footers
Uncommon three-star and Rare five-star marks
All twelve Personality stage charts, LEVEL and PUR values
Namek Dragon Ball 6 and 7 star counts and approved Porunga artwork
